name: Shanghai Suochen Information Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Suochen Information Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, sales, and service of CAE software. It offers products for engineering simulation, intelligent physics modeling, multi-field coupling analysis, and data-driven optimization. The company serves aerospace, automotive manufacturing, energy and power, low-altitude economy, and embodied intelligence industries. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Shanghai, China.
